⚠️ Thin day — 0 candidates

Ran all 25 standard discovery searches plus 2 targeted follow-up rounds (7 extra searches total) chasing the strongest-looking leads. Nothing survived Gate 1 (live signal confirmed against real data) once checked against IBKR. No action needed — cash stays parked, nothing to size today.

🔍 What happened in this scan

A generic "biggest gainers today" search returned a list of names supposedly up 80–145% intraday — Structure Therapeutics (GPCR), Wave Life Sciences (WVE), authID (AUID), Cemtrex (CETX). Every one of them was checked against a live IBKR price snapshot per the mandatory Gate 1 rule, and every one contradicted the search narrative — not just "faded," but trading at or near their own 52-week lows, in some cases down on the day. This is exactly the failure mode the skill's "IBKR wins when data disagrees" rule exists to catch, and it fired four times in one scan.

The remaining concrete names found across the earnings/upgrade/rotation searches (Nextracker, Shoals Technologies, SAIC, Tenet Healthcare, HCA, Zebra, Grainger, Dycom, PACS Group, Haemonetics) all had catalysts dated well outside the 5-trading-day freshness window — several were 2+ months old, one ("Nextracker Q2 FY26 beat") turned out to be from October 2025, a full year stale, due to a fiscal-year labeling mismatch. None showed a live breakout in IBKR's current price vs. 52-week range either.

Cut this run

GPCR (Structure Therapeutics) — search claimed +121.9% today; IBKR shows last $27.59, sitting at its own 13w/26w low, 71% off the 52w high of $94.90. Narrative false on arrival.
WVE (Wave Life Sciences) — search claimed +79.4%; IBKR shows last $3.75, at the 52-week low ($3.56). Narrative false on arrival.
AUID (authID) — search claimed +128.7%; IBKR shows last $0.466, down 7.17% on the day, near its 52w low. Also sub-$1 penny stock — would fail Gate 2 on its own.
CETX (Cemtrex) — search claimed +145.6%; IBKR shows last $1.95 near a fresh 52w low (down from a $97 high). Its only recent real catalyst on record was a US Navy SBIR contract — hard-excluded under the defense rule regardless.
NXT (Nextracker) — analyst PT raises exist (Barclays $105, TD Cowen $88) but the underlying "beat and raise" article was dated October 2025, not 2026 — a full year stale (fiscal-year label mismatch). IBKR shows last $82.97, 49% off the 52w high — no live breakout.
SHLS (Shoals Technologies) — Guggenheim PT raise cited "Q3 results last week," but SHLS's actual Q3 FY26 report isn't due until Nov 3 — the real reported quarter (Q2) was Aug 4, over 2 months stale. IBKR shows last $8.15, ~30% off the 26w high. No live signal.
SAIC — contract-driven stock jump, but the catalyst is a government/defense contract — hard-excluded, no exceptions.
Tenet Healthcare, HCA, Zebra Technologies, Grainger, Dycom, PACS Group, Haemonetics, Encompass Health — all genuine earnings-beat-and-raise movers, all 2+ months stale (Feb–Aug 2026 reports), none with a live technical signal in the last 5 trading days.

🎯 Today's best setup

No standout setup today. Nothing cleared even Gate 1. Forcing a pick from this list would mean trading a stale or contradicted narrative — exactly the mistake this skill exists to prevent.

What to do

Nothing. Stay in cash ($432 available). Next scheduled scan is Sunday (the Tue/Sun cadence). Say "find me something" any time between runs if you want an on-demand pull.
